finals.comment: Made a winning handicap and stable debut in a big-field Punchestown hurdle in May and, while below form back hurdling last time, her 3 placed efforts in maiden chases, most recently when second to Sea Of Light in a well-run Downpatrick event, make her a major player. Wears first-time cheekpieces.

finals.comment: Not far off useful on the Flat for Andreas Suborics, winning a maiden at Nancy in June and improving in defeat both starts since. Very interesting recruit to this company for leading yard.

finals.race: CopyBet Back Again At Hereford Fillies' Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Advertise filly who achieved little on the Flat. Similar story when beaten 33 lengths on hurdling debut at Fontwell (2¼m). She'll need to leave that effort well behind second time up.

finals.race: PricedUp Now With Best Odds 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: £40,000 5-y-o, Workforce gelding. Half-brother to 7f-1¼m winner in Italy by Arcano. Dam half-sister to fairly useful hurdler/chaser (stayed 33f) Hordago. Multiple winning Irish pointer, including last time (May 2026), and has to be of interest on Rules debut for in-form stable.

finals.race: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Dead-heated on third outing in points and readily surpassed his previous hurdling exploits when second of 10 in handicap at Fontwell (2¾m) in May. Made a winning start over fences in a 10-runner handicap chase at Ffos Las (3m, soft) last month, his jumping proving assured, and he can improve again.

finals.race: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Point runner-up who proved progressive over hurdles last season, second at Hexham in March before an excellent effort in a deep handicap at Punchestown (19f) the following month. Came a long way short of expectations on chase debut at Perth in September, though.

finals.race: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Placed on all 4 starts over hurdles, his mark looking about right when third of 11 in handicap hurdle (5/1) at Exeter (2¾m, good to soft) when last seen in March. Now 2 lb lower for chase debut, for which he sports a first-time tongue strap.

finals.race: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Hold-up type. Suited by the emphasis on speed when winning both starts since returning from a 6-month absence, latterly quickening clear in class 4 handicap at Huntingdon (2m). Eases back down in grade, and he may well extend his winning sequence. Engaged 12.50 Warwick Wednesday.

finals.race: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Point/bumper winner who made a successful return to hurdling at Musselburgh in December. Form of her subsequent second at the same track is solid, and she should be spot on for this following a keen-going fourth on return at Perth (3m) in late-September. Looks one of the more likely winners.
